Ruby & Snow

Hair half cherry-red and half snow-white, starburst lashes and a wide, happy grin, set on a field of coffee beans. Drawn by Nafas Elizabeth Pattrick at seven, for Nafas's Face Parade, and hung as one big portrait across the wall. sized to your wall's measurements on Smooth Matt.
